notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.content:
- Transport bot anti stuck routine is only active on follow mode 
- Changed the navigation priority on the Zombies 
- Matched objects speeds while on conveyor belt  
- Lowered the sound level on the saw blade 
- Navigation blocker added the B-spawn teleporter  
- Fixed some areas the player can get stuck in 
- Minor Bug Fixes

notes.title: The Game is Released!
notes.content: [p]Thanks everyone for the support and all the feedback! I hope you enjoy the game. As usual there will be bug fixes and updates. Please leave feedback in the community tab or on my Discord server. [/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy all the zombie killing-meat fishing action. [/p][p][/p][p]Also, [/p][p]the Fish God is a lie![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p]Chris [/p]
